# Aiarty

> > Aiarty is a next-generation AI platform for image and video enhancement, upscaling, and precision matting with desktop and mobile solutions.

Aiarty offers three core AI-powered products: Image Enhancer for upscaling and restoration, Video Enhancer for denoise and upscaling, and Image Matting for background removal. The platform serves both creative professionals and e-commerce users with desktop software and mobile apps.

## Key Topics

- Image Enhancement
- Video Enhancement
- Image Matting
- Background Removal
- AI Upscaling
- Super Resolution
- 4K/8K/32K Support
- Denoise & Deblur
- Batch Processing
- GPU Acceleration (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel)
- Product Photography
- E-commerce Tools
- Desktop & Mobile Apps
- AI-Generated Image Enhancement
- HDR/DNG/TIFF Support
